headlines.description: Pedro Neto scored twice in the second half to guide Chelsea to a 2-0 win at Everton on Saturday in a Premier League match marred by a serious-looking head injury to Chelsea goalkeeper Emi Martínez.
headlines.shortLinkText: Neto helps Chelsea end Everton's unbeaten run

headlines.description: Alexander Isak marked his return from injury with the winner as Liverpool came from behind to beat nine-man Brentford 2-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Isak seals Liverpool comeback at 9-man Brentford

headlines.description: Fulham's winless run under Alvaro Arbeloa was finally ended by an entertaining 1-0 victory over Hull at Craven Cottage.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arbeloa's Fulham earn first PL win of season

headlines.description: Erling Haaland struck twice as defiant Manchester City marched on at the top of the Premier League by holding on for a 3-2 win over Ipswich.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haaland brace helps City hold off Ipswich at defiant Eithad

headlines.description: Johan Manzambi scored the only goal of the game as Aston Villa clinched a 1-0 win over Newcastle at St James' Park.
headlines.shortLinkText:
Manzambi fires Villa to victory at St. James' Park
